# Dutch Van Duijnhoven / Van Duynhoven Family Database

Compiled from the **Open Archieven** public API (https://api.openarchieven.nl) across all six
civil-registry and church record types (BS Geboorte/Huwelijk/Overlijden, DTB Dopen/Trouwen/Begraven)
and all four surname spellings (*van Duijnhoven, van Duynhoven, Duijnhoven, Duynhoven*).

- **Total unique person-events harvested (all of NL):** 14,408
- **Year coverage in dataset:** 1607–1975
- **Rows in the focused table below (target Noord-Brabant villages, 1700–1950):** 5,563
- Generated: 2026-08-28

> **Note on the data model.** Open Archieven's search index returns one row per *Van Duijnhoven*
> person named on each record, with their role on that event (Kind = child/subject, Vader = father,
> Moeder = mother, Bruidegom = groom, Bruid = bride, Overledene = deceased, etc.). Non-family parties
> (e.g. a mother with a different maiden name) are not surfaced by a surname search, so the *Parents/Spouse*
> columns are populated only where the counterpart also carries the family surname or is a confirmed direct-line
> ancestor. Each row links to its source scan/record.

## 4. Reproducing / Extending This Search

```bash
# Birth records, primary spelling
curl -s "https://api.openarchieven.nl/1.0/records/search.json?name=van%20Duijnhoven&sourcetype=BS%20Geboorte&number_show=200"
# Full structured record (all parties + parents/spouse) for one identifier:
curl -s "https://api.openarchieven.nl/1.0/records/show.json?archive=bhi&identifier=<UUID>"
```

To pull parents/spouse for any focused row, call `show.json` with that record's archive code
(`bhi`, `gmb`, etc.) and identifier from its source link — the full record lists every party and
their `RelationType`, letting you assemble complete parent/child/spouse links on demand.
